blocks.content: Before you start styling, let's think about what makes a game look polished.

items: Layout - Everything should be centered and well-spaced
Colors - A consistent color scheme that looks professional
Typography - Clear, readable text with good font choices
Images - Visual elements that match the game's theme
Animations - Smooth transitions that feel responsive
Polish - Shadows, rounded corners, and small details
Center everything and add better spacing
Style the screens with backgrounds and colors
Replace the brown circle moles with actual mole images
Add a pop animation when moles are hit
Style buttons to look clickable and modern

blocks.content: You'll do this gradually, improving one thing at a time so you can see the difference each change makes!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
